t: Omni-directional work light with powerful 2000lm. Offers dual COB output with red hazard feature, magnetic handles and dimmer controls. Each COB panel and magnetic handle rotate to give light where required. Fully rechargeable and can serve as a power bank for USB-powered devices. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
